page.layout: Two columns of dictionary entries, side by side, separated by a central rule. Left column: lines 1 to 10 of entries, continuing into the right column at "fa-". Right column: lines continuing from "cta sunt" to the end. No margin notes, no footnotes. Running head and page numbers at top: left "y 5" (partly illegible), centre Hebrew marks, right "313".

main_text.l: f. m. aff. No. נַעַר; Rad. נַעַר
נָעֲרוּ excusserunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָעַר.
נְעָרוֹת, & נְעָרוֹת puellæ, נְעָרִים pueri, &c. pl. f. & pl. m. No. f. m. נַעַר; Rad. נַעַר
נַעֲרָ ordinabinus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. עָרַךְ
נֶעֶרְמוּ coacervatæ sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. עָרַם.
נֶעֱרַץ formidabilis est, vel נֶעֱרָץ formidabilis, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & Part. Niph. f. m. R. עָרַץ.
נַעֲרֵתִי excussi, præt. Kal, 1. f. R. נָעַר.
נַעֲרָתִי puellæ meæ, נַעֲרָתוֹ ejus, &c. pl. f. aff. No. f. fæm. נַעֲרָה, Rad. נַעַר excussit.
וַנַּעֲשֶׂה & fecimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. apoc. (pro נַעֲשָׂה) Rad. עָשָׂה.
cta sunt, נַעֲשָׂה factus, נַעֲשִׂים facti, נַעֲשׂוֹת fa-
cte, præt. Niph. 3. s. m. & 3. pl. & Part. Niph. s. m. & pl. m. & f. Rad. עָשָׂה.
הַנַּעֲשֶׂה an faciemus? fut. Kal, 1. plur. præf. Rad. עָשָׂה.
נַעֲשֶׂה faciemus illud, fut. Kal, 1. pl. aff. Rad. עָשָׂה.
נַעֲשָׂתָה, & נַעֲשְׂתָה facta est, præt. Niph. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. עָשָׂה.
נֶעְתַּם obscuratus est, præt. Niph. 3. sing. m. Rad. עָתַם.
נֶעְתָּר, & נֶעְתּוֹר vel נַעְתַּר exoratus fuit, 1 Par. 5. 20. pro נֶעְתָּר, vel נַעְתַּר; præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. עָתַר.
נֶעְתָּרוֹת exorate, Patt. Niph. plur. fæm. Rad. עָתַר.
נִפְרָתָה redempta fuit, præt. Niph. 3. sing. fæm. R r Rad.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and consonants were read at the limit of legibility; treat every Hebrew form as doubtful. Ink smudges and damp stains cover the left column near the middle and the right column near the top and bottom. Left line "ordinabinus" is printed so. The right column seems to have a shaded area (grey) around "נֶעְתָּר" to "R. עָתַר"; text there is readable but faint. The centre header Hebrew marks and the left running head ("y 5") are partly illegible.
